availability_rule: Only pivot evidence whose availability_timestamp is <= evaluation_availability_timestamp may be used.

sequence_rule.0003: current reaction peak > prior reaction peak AND current reaction trough > prior reaction trough
sequence_rule.0004: current reaction peak < prior reaction peak AND current reaction trough < prior reaction trough

peak_selection: At evaluation time, use the two latest confirmed HIGH pivots available by availability_timestamp.
trough_selection: Evaluate the current confirmed LOW against the immediately preceding confirmed LOW in chronological pivot order.
lookahead_policy: No future pivot may participate before its confirmation availability timestamp.
missing_evidence: Return NOT_EVALUABLE when either required side of the sequence is unavailable.
tuning_policy: No thresholds or pivot-generation parameters may be tuned from 2025 or from the evaluation outputs.
freeze_gate: Contract, implementation, unit tests, and 2016-2024 historical rerun must all pass before marking 0003-0004 production-frozen.
